description: Submits options and queues a hide or reveal job for a session whose files have all been uploaded. Hide jobs support the full set of encoding options; reveal jobs only use upload_uid, password, and expiry. The call is idempotent. Requires X-Api-Key header.

expiry.description: How long the result download link remains accessible after the job completes. Free-tier keys are silently clamped to upload.free_max_expiry (default 1d); Pro accounts get the requested value.

output_format.description: Hide only. Image format for stego output. All formats are lossless. Default: avif.

packing_strategy.description: Hide only. How secrets are distributed across covers. spread: alter each cover as little as possible (default). tight: pack multiple secrets per cover. quality: preserve visual quality above all else.

password.description: Encryption password. Required for hide and reveal. At least 8 characters with mixed case, a digit, and a symbol.

scale_secret_to_fit.description: Hide only. Auto-reduce secret size when it is too large to fit in its cover — images are resized, videos are compressed further. Set false to fail instead. Default: true.

secret_video_codec.description: Hide only, video secrets. Codec for compressing secret videos. h265 gives ~40% smaller payloads. Default: h265.

secret_video_crf.description: Hide only, video secrets. Compression quality for secret videos (lower = better quality, larger payload). Default: 28.

strip_cover_metadata.description: Hide only. Remove EXIF, GPS, and all embedded metadata from the stego output cover. Default: false.

strip_secret_metadata.description: Hide only. Remove EXIF, GPS, and embedded metadata from secret files before hiding. Reduces payload size. Default: false.

vault_profile_id.description: Pro accounts only, hide jobs only. ID of a Vault Profile to use as an additional key factor. Vault profiles are created and managed at /vault in the web UI. Returns error code -32002 on free accounts.

video_output_format.description: Hide only, video covers. Lossless codec and container for stego video output. Default: ffv1_mkv.

name: vaultify_job_start
